title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Charge for Accessories Not Returned
content:
1. **Billing.** Accessories the return inspection counted as not returned are billed once per agreement as one missing-accessory line, whatever condition the inspection recorded for the unit itself; damage protection never covers them, and equipment returned needing cleaning beyond normal use still incurs the class cleaning fee.
2. **Accessories charged.** The accessories charged are the accessories the return inspection counted as not returned.
3. **Charge.** The missing-accessory charge is the accessories charged multiplied by the class charge per accessory not returned, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end.

The class charge per accessory and the class cleaning fee are the Ridgeline Tool Rental figures on the return fee schedule. An accessory is a blade, bit, hose, pad or similar item rented with the unit.

## Worked examples (hypothetical returns)

| Class | Accessories counted as not returned | Unit condition recorded | Missing-accessory charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape, 20.00 per accessory | 3 | clean, no damage | 3 multiplied by 20.00, that is 60.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools, 10.00 per accessory | 1 | damaged | 10.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care, 15.00 per accessory | 2 | needing cleaning | 30.00, and the class cleaning fee as well |
| any class | 0 | any | none |

## Points of judgement

- *The unit also came back damaged. Does that replace the accessory charge?* No; the accessories are billed whatever condition the inspection recorded for the unit.
- *Does damage protection pay for a lost blade?* No; damage protection never covers missing accessories.
